column1: # architecture/baseline.tsv — the ratchet's exemptions (change package-structure-as-five-kinds, task 1.7).
# Columns, tab-separated, on every line below that does not start with #: file, rule, owning change.
# file is the project-relative path of a main source file; rule is the name of a rule in LayerRules the file
# is exempted from; owning change is the change that removes the entry by moving or fixing its file. The check
# refuses an entry that names no change and an entry whose file no longer violates the rule (spec
# architecture-test-suite — "The baseline is shrink-only"), so this file can only shrink.
# Measured 2026-11-14 by running the check with an empty baseline (this file holding no entries): 14 entries

# (ResultMarkings.kt carries both). The concept packages are the rows of architecture/structure.tsv whose kind
# is concept — com.naviveylin.core, com.naviveylin.concept and com.naviveylin.util — and the 11 are the Android
# importers of the 59 files in com.naviveylin.core: tools/look.sh '^import (android|androidx)\.' --path
